messages:
carmen: Quick sketch for SDK/api flags to control routing & fallback. thinking `region_hint`, `tier_override`, `allow_fallback` + a `debug` level that emits routing decisions to telemetry. want opinions on defaults and console UX. :thinking_face:

samir: +1 we need something explicit. default should be `region_hint=null` (best-effort routing), `allow_fallback=true` for PLG customers but `false` for reserved/dedicated customers unless they opt into fallback.

julia: Can we make `tier_override` only effective for header-authenticated requests? otherwise callers could spoof higher-tier routing. suggest SDK validate against key metadata.

carmen: good point. proposal: SDK exposes `tier_override` param but server will only honor it if token metadata contains `can_override_tier: true`. also emit an event when override used.

devex: UX note — console should show a toggle on route testing panel: "Honor client hints" vs "Server-controlled routing" with an audit of last 30 routing decisions. operators want to replay decisions for a specific trace id.

samir: telemetry needs these fields for each request: selected_region, selected_pool_type (hosted|dedicated|private), final_model_variant, fallback_reason (if any), decision_path. maintain small cardinality enums to avoid explosion.

mike_p: example header set I was using during testing:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <key>
X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1
X-Redwood-Tier: enterprise
X-Redwood-Allow-Fallback: true
X-Redwood-Debug: route_details
Content-Type: application/json
{ "model": "rw-large-v1", "input": "..." }
```

julia: +1 to the header names but prefer `X-Redwood-Route-Hint` instead of separate Region/Tier headers. single header reduces mismatch. e.g. `X-Redwood-Route-Hint: region=eu-west-1;tier=enterprise;probe=false`

carmen: Hmm I like compact hint header but SDKs should still offer explicit params. Also need `allow_degraded_variant` vs `allow_quantized_fallback` flags because fallback to a quantized variant has different quality/cost tradeoffs.

devex: console rollout UX — show a stacked timeline: primary model -> variant used -> fallback steps with percent of requests that hit each path. allow to toggle "disallow fallbacks for this route" during canary.

mike_p: question: how do we audit when fallback occurs due to capacity vs region outage vs per-tenant quota? we need distinct reasons for alerts.

samir: implement `fallback_reason` enum: CAPACITY_LIMIT, REGION_UNAVAILABLE, QUOTA_EXCEEDED, MODEL_INCOMPATIBLE, POLICY_BLOCKED. wire those into alerts so SRE can set thresholds.

ops-bot: deploy/job 2005006800: routing-service v3.14 rollout started to canary group 12%

carmen: thanks. final asks: (1) spec header/SDK params and server validation rules, (2) telemetry fields + low-cardinality enums, (3) console views for per-route routing audit + a toggle for honoring client hints, (4) rollout safety: enforce `allow_fallback=false` for reserved contracts unless explicit opt-in.

julia: I'll draft the spec and include the sample headers and SDK signatures. will ping for review when ready. :eyes:"
